chapter: Wagon bands, halls and the old brass bands
title: Buddy Petit, the Diminished King, and the funky bands
summary: Danny calls Buddy Petit a fantastic player from whom Louis allegedly got diminished ideas; he was boss after King Oliver.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: But then they had the funky bands that played for the people, like Buddy Petit and Kid Rena. Buddy Petit was a fantastic musician. Reminds me some of Charlie Shavers. He was called "The Diminished King." Louis got all them diminished things, that's what everybody said, from Buddy. Because Buddy was older than Louis. Buddy was the boss after King Oliver. See, Bunk disappeared, so it left the mantle to King Oliver...
